get.summary: List Members or Get a Member
get.description: Without id/email, returns a paginated list of members. If id or email is provided, returns a single member. List filters combine, with product_id taking precedence over offer_id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: If provided, returns the member with this ID instead of a list.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: If provided (and id not given), returns the member with this email instead of a list.

parameters.name: min_points
parameters.description: Minimum all-time points, inclusive. Members without points count as zero. Requires leaderboards to be enabled. Omit or leave blank for no minimum.

parameters.name: max_points
parameters.description: Maximum all-time points, inclusive. Requires leaderboards to be enabled. Omit or leave blank for no maximum.

parameters.name: min_level
parameters.description: Minimum current level, inclusive. Members without level history count as level 1. Requires levels to be enabled. Omit or leave blank for no minimum.

parameters.name: max_level
parameters.description: Maximum current level, inclusive. Requires levels to be enabled. Omit or leave blank for no maximum.

parameters.name: min_coaching_used
parameters.description: Minimum coaching usage, inclusive. Requires coaching_type_id. Measured in hours for timed coaching or sessions otherwise, including future published appointments. No appointments count as zero. Omit or leave blank for no minimum.

parameters.name: max_coaching_used
parameters.description: Maximum coaching usage, inclusive. Requires coaching_type_id. Measured in hours for timed coaching or sessions otherwise, including future published appointments. No appointments count as zero. Omit or leave blank for no maximum.

parameters.name: consultation_category_id
parameters.description: Filter by current offer access to this consultation category. Excludes expired, inactive or deleted accesses and deleted offers. Subscriptions must be active or trialing. Omit or leave blank for no filter.

parameters.name: live_category_id
parameters.description: Filter by current offer access to this live category. Excludes expired, inactive or deleted accesses and deleted offers. Subscriptions must be active or trialing. Omit or leave blank for no filter.

parameters.name: coaching_type_id
parameters.description: Filter by current offer access to this coaching type. Excludes expired, inactive or deleted accesses and deleted offers. Subscriptions must be active or trialing. Omit or leave blank for no filter.

parameters.name: ai_assistant_id
parameters.description: Filter by current offer access to this AI coach. Excludes expired, inactive or deleted accesses and deleted offers. Subscriptions must be active or trialing. Omit or leave blank for no filter.

200.description: List of members (when no id/email) or a single member (when id/email provided).

get.description: Retrieves conversation groups for the required user_id. Participant filters narrow that user's history.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Required ID of the user whose conversation history to retrieve. The user must belong to your school.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Follow next_page until null.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search title, non-deleted message content, or participant name/email.

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: Filter the selected user's conversations by a participating member ID.

parameters.name: participant_user_id
parameters.description: Filter the selected user's conversations by another participating user ID.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Filter by a participant's email, ignoring case and surrounding spaces. No match returns no conversations. When several participant filters are supplied, any match is included.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter the selected user's conversations by unread, followed or archived status, or by step completion.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Use true for archived conversations only or false to exclude them. Can be combined with another filter. filter=archived takes precedence.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by latest activity by default. Matching activity dates are ordered by conversation ID.

url.description: Relative conversation path in the school.

lesson_type.description: Lesson type. Changing it keeps existing steps and media. Null is not accepted.

drip_delay.description: Additional delay in days, from 0 to 32767. Null is not accepted. Adds to the section unlock time, including the member drip boost. If program access has a drip start date, uses the earliest start date plus section and lesson delays, without the boost. Progression locks and access restrictions still apply.

name.description: Lesson title, up to 255 characters. Cannot be blank or null.

description.description: Lesson description, up to 200000 characters. Send null to clear it. Use content_format=markdown to convert Markdown to HTML.

body.description: Lesson content in HTML, or Markdown with content_format=markdown. Maximum 200000 characters. Send null to clear it. Responses return HTML. Scripts, iframes, object and embed tags, and attachment markup are not accepted. Use the video or embed fields for embedded media. Use HTML blockquote tags for quotes because Markdown blockquotes display as ordinary text.

content_format.description: Format of the body and description sent in this request. Use html (default when omitted or null) or markdown. Responses return HTML. This does not change content omitted from the request.

position.description: Position in the section, starting at 1. Inserting at an occupied position moves later lessons down. Omit to keep the current order, or place the lesson last when moving sections. Null is not accepted. Zero is accepted, but positions starting at 1 are recommended. Deleting a lesson does not renumber the others.

is_progression_locked.description: Lock the rest of the program until members complete all steps in this lesson. If a drip delay also applies, both conditions must be met. Send false or null to turn the lock off.

is_published.description: Publish this lesson or send false to keep it as a draft. Program publication and member access still apply. Null is not accepted.

settings_embed_wistia.description: Wistia video ID or supported HTTP(S) share, watch or embed URL for lesson_type=video. URLs are saved as IDs. Send null or an empty string to clear it. A changed nonblank value clears the other video providers and settings_embed_code, while keeping embed_code. Supply one video source. For multiple changed sources, priority is Wistia, YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, then settings_embed_code.

settings_embed_vimeo.description: Vimeo video ID or supported HTTP(S) share, watch or embed URL for lesson_type=video. URLs are saved as IDs. Send null or an empty string to clear it. A changed nonblank value clears the other video providers and settings_embed_code, while keeping embed_code. Supply one video source. For multiple changed sources, priority is Wistia, YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, then settings_embed_code.

settings_embed_youtube.description: YouTube video ID or supported HTTP(S) share, watch or embed URL for lesson_type=video. URLs are saved as IDs. Send null or an empty string to clear it. A changed nonblank value clears the other video providers and settings_embed_code, while keeping embed_code. Supply one video source. For multiple changed sources, priority is Wistia, YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, then settings_embed_code.

settings_embed_loom.description: Loom video ID or supported HTTP(S) share, watch or embed URL for lesson_type=video. URLs are saved as IDs. Send null or an empty string to clear it. A changed nonblank value clears the other video providers and settings_embed_code, while keeping embed_code. Supply one video source. For multiple changed sources, priority is Wistia, YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, then settings_embed_code.

settings_embed_code.description: Custom video embed HTML for lesson_type=video. Send null or an empty string to clear it. A changed nonblank value clears video provider fields unless a changed provider takes precedence. The separate embed_code field is kept. Supply one video source per request.

embed_code.description: Custom HTML for lesson_type=embed. Send null or an empty string to clear it. This is separate from settings_embed_code and keeps any video provider settings. Changing lesson_type selects which content to display.

lesson_type.description: Lesson type. Changing it keeps existing steps and media. Null is not accepted.

drip_delay.description: Additional delay in days, from 0 to 32767. Null is not accepted. Adds to the section unlock time, including the member drip boost. If program access has a drip start date, uses the earliest start date plus section and lesson delays, without the boost. Progression locks and access restrictions still apply.

section_id.description: Move this lesson to another section in the school, keeping its steps, content and attachments. Requires edit access to both programs. If position is omitted, the lesson is placed last in the destination section. Null is not accepted.

LessonUpdateRequest.description: Send fields directly or inside attributes. Omitted fields keep their current values. JSON numbers and booleans must use their native types. Form requests accept number and boolean values, including nested fields such as attributes[is_published]. Use JSON for null values. Empty strings and the text null are not treated as null.

purchased_at.description: When access was granted, including free and manual grants. This does not confirm a payment.

progression_rate.description: Percentage of required published steps completed using current program access.

coaching.description: Coaching usage and the last appointment date include future published appointments.

body.description: Plain text comment body.

rank.description: All-time leaderboard position. Null when the member is excluded.

MemberAudit.description: Leaderboard and level are included when enabled. Use page for the main lists and lessons_page for unfinished lessons.

profile_picture_url.description: Profile picture URL, or null when no picture is set.

result.description: Result of the completed operation. Fields depend on the operation.
